events.title: We have a release date, Diecast is coming on the 3rd of November!
events.summary: Hello high rollers! I’m very excited to share that we officially have a release date: November 3rd! Tell you friends, tell your parents, tell your dog! Some infoWishlist and share: Any help we can get with spreading the word about Diecast is worth a lot to us! If you enjoyed the demo and want to support the release, tell a friend! Demo plans: The Demo will be still be available after release, but progression will not carry over into the full game as unlocks have been completely reworked!Playtest

events.title: Diecast is joining Secret Sauce!
events.summary: Hey high rollers! Today I have an exciting announcement! Diecast will be participating in this year's Secret Sauce Showcase, airing July 16th, 10 AM PT/1PM ET. Diecast will be small part of a much bigger showcase, showing many awesome games coming up! I'll be sharing an update later this week with info on where to tune in! Also, look forward to some news on a brand new demo coming out soon™️ with brand-new content!Talk soon,sofamire

events.title: Two New Pins + Playtest End Date
events.summary: Hello high rollers! The final update for this playtest is out! This update adds the final two pins. Wait, final two? Read about them below: 📍White Hole (legendary) - Odds for DICE and PINS are increased by 1 (1 in 3 becomes 2 in 3). 📍Black Hole (exotic) - Odds for DICE and PINS are decreased by 1 (1 in 3 becomes 0 in 3). My only advice for these is this: Don't get one of each. If you work the math out you'll understand why. Playtest AnnouncementWith this update, I've released all planned content

events.title: Pins Update! Acoustic Guitar + Electric Guitar
events.summary: Hello high rollers!This update introduces two new pins, with the first brand new permanent abilities. Read on below: Acoustic Guitar (common) +2 POINTS permanently for each even numbered die scored in HAND Electric Guitar (common) +1 MULT permanently for each odd numbered die scored in HANDUntil the next update, each of these pins will have a 1 in 3 chance of appearing when common items spawn, so they should be much easier to find and experiment with for a limited time.More news to share soon!Ha

events.title: Diecast is a part of Strategems on Steam! + Open playtest begins!
events.summary: Hello everyone!Diecast is a part of the Strategems 2026 festival! There are a lot of awesome games, demos, and discounts, including the announcement of the open playtest for Diecast! Which, by the way, is available NOW 😁Share the event with your friends, family, and pets! Then, play the game and join the Discord to let me know what you love and hate, (and most importantly what mildly annoys you).Happy rolling,sofamire
